entries.0b352745e111565b: It develops, manufactures and sells measurement and control devices such as signal generators and frequency response analyzers, power supply equipment such as AC and DC power supplies, and storage battery systems and protective relay testers. In addition, it provides calibration and repair services for the products it has sold.
entries.0e8bbdf4ec98eca0: It sets as its envisioned goal to become a "leading company in measurement and control" that is recognized by society and expected to create and provide new value that resonates with people. Based on its three businesses—measurement and control device-related, power supply and power control-related, and environmental energy-related—it aims to build a business model that is less affected by capital investment by providing highly competitive products built around original technology. In addition, it is working on future investments such as the development of domestically produced quantum computer-related products, and on establishing a total solutions sales structure.
entries.0fff1559a59df561: The group consists of NF HOLDINGS CORPORATION and six consolidated subsidiaries. Its head office is in Kohoku-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 283.

entries.88b4576c1a8fd70b: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, efforts were made to expand existing technologies into new markets, including expanding into medical measurement by applying micro-signal and impedance measurement technologies, and strengthening the structure for industrial storage battery systems by leveraging high-power conversion technology. While it has wound down its business in household storage battery systems, it is restructuring its business toward industrial storage battery systems and markets for renewable energy use such as hydrogen.

entries.951f6e53e7467aff: This field handles signal generators, frequency response analyzers, minute signal measuring instruments, impedance measuring instruments, seismic measurement-related equipment, and various functional modules such as filters, amplifiers, phase detectors and piezo drivers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,370 million. Standard products as well as custom-made and repeat products are sold to industry, government and academia for research and development, to semiconductor and other manufacturing equipment, and to electronic equipment for aerospace and railway infrastructure.
entries.9e870785719870e6: This is the business of a group consisting of the company and six consolidated subsidiaries. It is a single segment, which develops, manufactures and sells equipment related to measurement and control devices, power supply and power control, environmental energy and other equipment, and provides calibration and repair services incidental to these. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,138 million. The core subsidiary, NF Circuit Design Block Co., Ltd., handles development, manufacture and sales, and a subsidiary in Yamaguchi City, Yamaguchi Prefecture, handles manufacture of electronic devices and semi-finished products (boards) and manufacture of equipment.
